messages:
Alex (Community): 🎉 Quick heads-up — we just cut contrib-scripts/ops-kit v0.4.0 and pushed the release notes + a short maintainer update. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-scripts
Alex (Community): What’s new: on-prem install helper, improved audit-log parsers, templated rollout configs, and a lightweight HA probe for Dedicated. Full changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-scripts/releases/tag/v0.4.0
Alex (Community): Maintainer notes: jamie and rachel are joining the maintainer rotation for ops-kit. We’re also holding maintainer office hours next Wed 09:00 PT (live) and a community bug-squash on Sat 15:00 UTC. Everyone welcome :tada:
release-bot: release  v0.4.0 published by Alex (Community) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-scripts/releases/tag/v0.4.0
Elena (Product): awesome. Does the on-prem installer require any schema changes to customer configs? worried about upgrade friction.
Mateo (Eng): short answer: no breaking schema changes. The installer reads the same config keys but supports a new optional field `ha_probe`.
Mateo (Eng): upgrade command for testing locally:
```
pip install contrib-scripts==0.4.0
redwood-ops init --config ./prod.yaml --dry-run
```
Priya (DevEx): added a small migration guide + example configs to the docs site — link in the changelog. Will follow up with a short how-to notebook for Getting Started.
jamie (Maintainer): happy to pair on the office hours. I’ll bring a checklist for on-prem validation and a quick demo of the audit-log parser.
rachel (Maintainer): if folks want to transfer test infra to our sandbox, DM me and I’ll add you.
Elena (Product): can we get a short blurb for the customer-facing release notes (non-technical)?
Alex (Community): yes — will draft a short blurb and post in #marketing after this thread. TL;DR: easier on-prem deployment, better observability helpers, new maintainer coverage.
Priya (DevEx): tagging some quick test cases here: metrics ingestion, audit log rotation, and HA probe flapping. If you have automated tests, please run them before office hours.
Jamie (Maintainer): minor FYI — we bumped a transitive dependency for better Windows path handling. No impact on Linux.
Mateo (Eng): :+1: also added a fallback that keeps previous behavior if ha_probe absent.
release-bot: GitHub Actions: artifact uploaded (sha: f3c9e2b) — checks passed
Alex (Community): community event details: office hours (Wed 09:00 PT — meet in #community-office-hours + Zoom), bug-squash (Sat 15:00 UTC — pairing rooms will be created). RSVP by reacting :hand:
Elena (Product): :hand: will slot it in the product newsletter
Priya (DevEx): :hand: will create the how-to notebook PR today
jamie (Maintainer): count me in for both. Will put together a 10-min demo deck.
rachel (Maintainer): will drop a couple of starter issues labeled "good-first-bug" for the bug-squash.
Alex (Community): thanks all. If you find a regression, open an issue with the template and tag @jamie and @rachel. See you at the office hours!
